name: planetscale
description: Connect PlanetScale to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use PlanetScale MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect PlanetScale to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with databases, branches and query insights using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my PlanetScale workspace.
Find anything in PlanetScale that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review databases, branches and query insights in PlanetScale.
